message.example: Baseer API is healthy and operational

isGuest.description: Whether the user is an anonymous guest

accessToken.description: Short-lived access token used for Bearer authentication

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token used to obtain new access tokens

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred interface language for guest user

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to revoke. If omitted, revokes current session.

speechRate.description: Speech rate for TTS announcements between 0.50 and 3.00

highContrastEnabled.description: Enable high contrast color scheme on mobile application

hapticEnabled.description: Enable haptic vibration feedback for warnings and obstacles

voiceWakeWordEnabled.description: Enable voice wake word detection (Hey Baseer / بصير)

accepted.description: Whether this consent is actively granted

policyVersion.description: Policy version corresponding to this consent response

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this consent was recorded or updated

policyVersion.description: Latest policy version consented or evaluated by the user

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when consent choices last changed

consents.description: Array of consent statuses per category

accepted.description: Whether the user explicitly accepted or rejected this consent

policyVersion.description: Version identifier of the policy the user responded to

consents.description: List of consent records to save atomically

requestId.description: Unique trace identifier for this request execution (UUID)

status.description: Current status of the task execution

errorCode.description: Error code if the task execution failed

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task execution was created

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the task execution completed, failed, or was cancelled

result.description: Temporary task execution result when completed (available only in Redis within 2-hour TTL; never stored in persistent DB)

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the deletion request

capability.description: High-entropy capability secret required to check deletion status. Returned ONLY once upon creation. Store securely on client.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the deletion request was accepted into the system

status.description: Current status of the deletion request

stageStatus.description: Granular status of individual deletion stages

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the deletion request was accepted

completedAt.description: Timestamp when account deletion was fully completed

failureCode.description: Non-sensitive failure code if the request failed

id.description: Unique identifier of destination point of interest

startLocation.description: Human-readable starting point name detected from QR code

estimatedDistanceMeters.description: Estimated distance in meters to target destination

totalSteps.description: عدد الخطوات الإرشادية في المسار (Number of instructional guidance steps in route)

example: وجهتك هي الباب الثاني على يسارك (شؤون الطلبة)
voiceInstructions.description: Sequential voice guidance instructions in Arabic

currentQrCode.description: Current scanned QR code identifier. Allowed QR codes: QR_ENTRANCE_01, QR_HALLWAY_A, QR_ELEVATOR_01, QR_STAIRS_EAST. Fake test triggers: "invalid" -> ERR_INVALID_QR_CODE, "notfound" -> ERR_QR_NOT_FOUND.

destinationId.description: Target destination ID (from GET /destinations). Fake test triggers: "invalid" -> ERR_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND, "routeerror" -> ERR_ROUTE_CALCULATION_FAILED.

extractedText.example: Panadol Extra 500mg - Take 2 tablets every 8 hours after meals.
extractedText.description: Raw extracted text from the image

arabicSimplifiedText.example: بنادول إكسترا 500 مجم - قرصين كل 8 ساعات بعد الأكل
arabicSimplifiedText.description: Simplified Arabic spoken text tailored for text-to-speech

imageBase64.description: Base64 encoded image string (JPEG/PNG). Testing fake triggers: send "blurry" for ERR_IMAGE_BLURRY, "dark" for ERR_IMAGE_TOO_DARK, "notext" for ERR_NO_TEXT_DETECTED (OCR only), "unsupported" for ERR_UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_FORMAT, "toolarge" for ERR_FILE_TOO_LARGE, "lowconfidence" for ERR_LOW_CONFIDENCE, or "timeout" for ERR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.

userInput.example: شوفلي الورقة دي مكتوب فيها إيه

confidence.description: Confidence score of intent classification (0 to 1), or null if model does not supply genuine score

spokenResponse.example: تمام، وجه الكاميرا نحو الورقة وسأقرأها لك حالاً
spokenResponse.description: Spoken confirmation in Egyptian Arabic for text-to-speech

actionToTriggerOnMobile.description: Specific mobile camera or screen mode to automatically trigger. Null when command requires user clarification.

requiresClarification.description: Indicates whether the assistant requires verbal clarification from the user before executing an action

entities.description: Extracted semantic entities or missing slot indicators

userSpeech.example: شوفلي الورقة دي مكتوب فيها إيه
userSpeech.description: Recognized Arabic speech transcript captured on mobile device

language.description: Spoken language/dialect locale of the speech input

description.example: أمامك طاولة خشبية عليها زجاجة ماء ومفتاح، وعلى يمينك مقعد فارغ
description.description: Natural Arabic scene narration for text-to-speech

confidence.description: Overall vision detection confidence score (0 to 1)

condition.description: Physical condition or banknote series note

disclaimer.example: قد تتأثر دقة اللون بإضاءة الغرفة الحالية

spokenMeaning.example: إشارة عبور مشاة، يمكنك العبور بحذر

spokenDescription.example: الشخص الذي أمامك يبتسم ويبدو سعيداً

hazardDetected.description: Whether an active proximity hazard is detected

obstacleType.description: Type or classification of detected obstacle in Arabic

distanceMeters.description: Estimated distance in meters to obstacle

hapticAlertPattern.description: Recommended mobile haptic vibration feedback pattern

spokenWarning.example: انتبه! أمامك درجات سلم على بعد خطوتين

transcript.description: Transcribed Arabic or English text from the audio input

language.description: Detected or requested speech language locale

confidence.description: Transcription confidence score between 0 and 1, or null if unavailable
